title: Sada ran se deti
body:
sada ran se deti thi ek laashe besar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
ye daaghe yateemi hai tera muqaddar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
idhar aa kaleje se apne lagaloo
idhar aa mai seene pe tujhko sulaloo
idhar aa meri jaan mai qurban tujh par
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
ye sunsaan sehra ye veeran jangal
ghazab ka andhera ye khamosh maqtal
na ghabra chali aa sambhal kar sambhal kar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe dekhna hai mera zakhme khanjar
tujhe dekhna hai meri laashe besar
tujhe dekhna hai ye dil soz manzar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
jo sajde mein haq ke jhuka tha wohi sar
nazar aayega tujhko noke sina par
badan par hai ab rayge sehra ki chadar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
rulayegi tujhko bahot yaad meri
sunega na koi bhi faryaad teri
satayega raste mein shimr e sitamgar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
ab andaz badlega sone ka tere
sulayegi aaghosh mein tujhko madar
yahan mere seene pe soyega asghar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
tera sin nahi gham uthane ke khaabil
kathin hai tere imtehano ki manzil
ali ko sada de khuda se dua kar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
viqar e hazeen kya bayan ho wo manzar
jo dekha tha usne kahoo ab mai kyunkar
badi jab sakina ye awaaz sunkar
idhar aa idhar aa sakina sakina
author: Viqar Nagri
